findings.mechanism: 03-errors-as-interface – the function swallows verification errors and returns null, allowing malformed or tampered JWTs to be treated as valid claims, a silent failure that can pass as success
findings.remediation: Replace jwt.decode with jwt.verify using the SECRET, and return null only when verification throws; propagate verification errors instead of silently returning null
findings.arithmetic: jwt.decode does not verify signature, so any malformed token (probability 1) yields a Claims object. Authorized responses return HTTP 200, unauthorized should return 401. Because verification is omitted, unauthorized requests receive 200, i.e., status >=200 instead of 401
